verses.original: בְּ֭נִי תּוֹרָתִ֣י אַל־ תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י יִצֹּ֥ר לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî tō·w·rā·ṯî ’al- tiš·kāḥ ū·miṣ·wō·ṯay yiṣ·ṣōr lib·be·ḵā
verses.literal: My son do not forget my teaching but let your heart keep my commandments
verses.literalPt: Filho meu, não te esqueças da minha instrução, mas guarde o teu coração os meus mandamentos;

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים וּשְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּ֑ים וְ֝שָׁל֗וֹם יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ō·reḵ yā·mîm ū·šə·nō·wṯ ḥay·yîm wə·šā·lō·wm yō·w·sî·p̄ū lāḵ
verses.literal: for they will add length to your days years and peace to your life
verses.literalPt: pois eles te darão longura de dias, anos de vida e paz.

verses.original: חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֗ת אַֽל־ יַעַ֫זְבֻ֥ךָ קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־ גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ ’al- ya·‘az·ḇu·ḵā qā·šə·rêm ‘al- gar·gə·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā kā·ṯə·ḇêm ‘al- lū·aḥ lib·be·ḵā
verses.literal: Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you bind them around your neck write them on the tablet of your heart
verses.literalPt: Não te abandonem a benignidade e a verdade; ata-as à roda do teu pescoço, escreve-as na tábua do teu coração.

verses.original: וּמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן וְשֵֽׂכֶל־ ט֑וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאָדָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·mə·ṣā- ḥên wə·śê·ḵel- ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Then you will find favor and high regard . . . in the sight of God and man
verses.literalPt: Assim, acharás graça e verdadeira prudência à vista de Deus e dos homens.

verses.original: בְּטַ֣ח אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְאֶל־ בִּֽ֝ינָתְךָ֗ אַל־ תִּשָּׁעֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭaḥ ’el- Yah·weh bə·ḵāl lib·be·ḵā wə·’el- bî·nā·ṯə·ḵā ’al- tiš·šā·‘ên
verses.literal: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding
verses.literalPt: Confia, de todo o teu coração, em Jeová e não te estribes no teu próprio entendimento.

verses.original: בְּכָל־ דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ דָעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יְיַשֵּׁ֥ר אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵe·ḵā ḏā·‘ê·hū wə·hū yə·yaš·šêr ’ō·rə·ḥō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: in all your ways acknowledge Him and He will make your paths straight
verses.literalPt: Reconhece-o em todos os teus caminhos, e ele endireitará as tuas veredas.

verses.original: אַל־ תְּהִ֣י חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ יְרָ֥א אֶת־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·hî ḥā·ḵām bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā yə·rā ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·sūr mê·rā‘
verses.literal: Be not wise in your own eyes fear the LORD and turn away from evil
verses.literalPt: Não sejas sábio aos teus próprios olhos; teme a Jeová e aparta-te do mal.

verses.original: רִ֭פְאוּת תְּהִ֣י לְשָׁרֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝שִׁקּ֗וּי לְעַצְמוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: rip̄·’ūṯ tə·hî lə·šār·re·ḵā wə·šiq·qui lə·‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones
verses.literalPt: Isso será saúde para o teu umbigo e regadura para os teus ossos.

verses.original: כַּבֵּ֣ד אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה מֵהוֹנֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מֵרֵאשִׁ֗ית כָּל־ תְּבוּאָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kab·bêḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh mê·hō·w·ne·ḵā ū·mê·rê·šîṯ kāl- tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your crops
verses.literalPt: Honra a Jeová com a tua fazenda e com as primícias de toda a tua renda.

verses.original: וְיִמָּלְא֣וּ אֲסָמֶ֣יךָ שָׂבָ֑ע וְ֝תִיר֗וֹשׁ יְקָבֶ֥יךָ יִפְרֹֽצוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·yim·mā·lə·’ū ’ă·sā·me·ḵā śā·ḇā‘ wə·ṯî·rō·wōš yə·qā·ḇe·ḵā yip̄·rō·ṣū
verses.literal: then your barns will be filled with plenty and your vats will overflow with new wine
verses.literalPt: Assim, se encherão de fartura os teus celeiros, e trasbordarão de mosto os teus lagares.

verses.original: מוּסַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה בְּנִ֣י אַל־ תִּמְאָ֑ס וְאַל־ תָּ֝קֹ֗ץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mū·sar Yah·weh bə·nî ’al- tim·’ās wə·’al- tā·qōṣ bə·ṯō·w·ḵaḥ·tōw
verses.literal: My son do not reject the discipline of the LORD and do not loathe His rebuke
verses.literalPt: Filho meu, não rejeites a instrução de Jeová, nem te enojes da sua repreensão;

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶ֥ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶאֱהַ֣ב יְהוָ֣ה יוֹכִ֑יחַ וּ֝כְאָ֗ב אֶת־ בֵּ֥ן יִרְצֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ ’ă·šer ye·’ĕ·haḇ Yah·weh yō·w·ḵî·aḥ ū·ḵə·’āḇ ’eṯ- bên yir·ṣeh
verses.literal: for the LORD disciplines the one He loves as does a father the son in whom he delights
verses.literalPt: porque Jeová repreende ao que ama, assim como o pai ao filho no qual se deleita.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מָצָ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝אָדָ֗ם יָפִ֥יק תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê ’ā·ḏām mā·ṣā ḥāḵ·māh wə·’ā·ḏām yā·p̄îq tə·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: Blessed is the man who finds wisdom the man who acquires understanding
verses.literalPt: Feliz é o homem que acha sabedoria, e o que adquire o entendimento.

verses.original: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב סַ֭חְרָהּ מִסְּחַר־ כָּ֑סֶף וּ֝מֵחָר֗וּץ תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṭō·wḇ saḥ·rāh mis·sə·ḥar- kā·sep̄ ū·mê·ḥā·rūṣ tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯāh
verses.literal: for she is more profitable . . . than silver and her gain is better than fine gold
verses.literalPt: Pois melhor é o lucro que ela dá do que o lucro da prata, e o que ela rende, do que o ouro fino.

verses.original: יְקָ֣רָה הִ֭יא מִפְּנִיִּים וְכָל־ חֲ֝פָצֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ־ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·qā·rāh hî mip·pə·nī·yīm wə·ḵāl ḥă·p̄ā·ṣe·ḵā lō yiš·wū- ḇāh
verses.literal: She is more precious than rubies nothing . . . you desire compares with her
verses.literalPt: Mais preciosa é do que os corais, e nada do que podes desejar é para ser comparado com ela.

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים בִּֽימִינָ֑הּ בִּ֝שְׂמֹאולָ֗הּ עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·reḵ yā·mîm bî·mî·nāh biś·mō·w·lāh ‘ō·šer wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: Long life is in her right hand in her left hand are riches and honor
verses.literalPt: A longura de dias está na sua mão direita, na sua esquerda, riquezas e honra.

verses.original: דְּרָכֶ֥יהָ דַרְכֵי־ נֹ֑עַם וְֽכָל־ נְתִ֖יבוֹתֶ֣יהָ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: də·rā·ḵe·hā ḏar·ḵê- nō·‘am wə·ḵāl nə·ṯî·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: All her ways . . . are pleasant and all her paths are peaceful
verses.literalPt: Os seus caminhos são caminhos aprazíveis, e todas as suas veredas são paz.

verses.original: עֵץ־ חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַמַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑הּ וְֽתֹמְכֶ֥יהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘êṣ- ḥay·yîm hî lam·ma·ḥă·zî·qîm bāh wə·ṯō·mə·ḵe·hā mə·’uš·šār
verses.literal: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her and those who lay hold of her are blessed
verses.literalPt: É árvore de vida para os que dela lançam mão, e feliz é todo aquele que a retém.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּחָכְמָ֥ה יָֽסַד־ אָ֑רֶץ כּוֹנֵ֥ן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם בִּתְבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bə·ḥā·ḵə·māh yā·saḏ- ’ā·reṣ kō·w·nên šā·ma·yim biṯ·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: The LORD founded the earth by wisdom and established the heavens by understanding
verses.literalPt: Jeová, pela sabedoria, fundou a terra, pelo entendimento, estabeleceu os céus.

verses.original: בְּ֭דַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמ֣וֹת נִבְקָ֑עוּ וּ֝שְׁחָקִ֗ים יִרְעֲפוּ־ טָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḏa‘·tōw tə·hō·w·mō·wṯ niḇ·qā·‘ū ū·šə·ḥā·qîm yir·‘ă·p̄ū- ṭāl
verses.literal: By His knowledge the watery depths were broken open and the clouds dripped with dew
verses.literalPt: pelo seu conhecimento, se fenderam os abismos, e as nuvens destilam o orvalho.

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אַל־ יָלֻ֣זוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ נְצֹ֥ר תֻּ֝שִׁיָּ֗ה וּמְזִמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’al- yā·lu·zū mê·‘ê·ne·ḵā nə·ṣōr tu·šî·yāh ū·mə·zim·māh
verses.literal: My son do not lose sight of this Preserve sound judgment and discernment
verses.literalPt: Filho meu, não se apartem essas coisas de diante dos teus olhos. Guarda a verdadeira sabedoria e a discrição.

verses.original: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ חַיִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְ֝חֵ֗ן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yih·yū ḥay·yîm lə·nap̄·še·ḵā wə·ḥên lə·ḡar·gə·rō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: They will be life to your soul and adornment to your neck
verses.literalPt: Assim, serão elas vida para a tua alma e graça, para o teu pescoço.

verses.original: אָ֤ז תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לָבֶ֣טַח דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝רַגְלְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִגּֽוֹף׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz tê·lêḵ lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ dar·ke·ḵā wə·raḡ·lə·ḵā lō ṯig·gō·wp̄
verses.literal: Then you will go on your way in safety and your foot will not stumble
verses.literalPt: Então, andarás seguro pelo teu caminho, e não tropeçará o teu pé.

verses.original: אִם־ תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב לֹֽא־ תִפְחָ֑ד וְ֝שָׁכַבְתָּ֗ וְֽעָרְבָ֥ה שְׁנָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tiš·kaḇ lō- ṯip̄·ḥāḏ wə·šā·ḵaḇ·tā wə·‘ā·rə·ḇāh šə·nā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: When you lie down you will not be afraid when you rest your sleep will be sweet
verses.literalPt: Quando te deitares, não temerás; deitar-te-ás, e o teu sono será suave.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹ֑ם וּמִשֹּׁאַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים כִּ֣י תָבֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rā mip·pa·ḥaḏ piṯ·’ōm ū·miš·šō·’aṯ rə·šā·‘îm kî ṯā·ḇō
verses.literal: Do not fear sudden danger or the ruin that overtakes the wicked
verses.literalPt: Não temas o pavor repentino, nem a assolação dos perversos quando vier.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְ֭הוָה יִהְיֶ֣ה בְכִסְלֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁמַ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מִלָּֽכֶד׃
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh yih·yeh ḇə·ḵis·le·ḵā wə·šā·mar raḡ·lə·ḵā mil·lā·ḵeḏ
verses.literal: for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from the snare
verses.literalPt: Porque Jeová será a tua confiança e guardará ao teu pé para que não seja apanhado.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּמְנַע־ ט֥וֹב מִבְּעָלָ֑יו בִּהְי֨וֹת לְאֵ֖ל יָדֶיךָ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tim·na‘- ṭō·wḇ mib·bə·‘ā·lāw bih·yō·wṯ lə·’êl yå̄·ḏɛ·ḵå̄ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: Do not withhold good from the deserving when it is within your power to act
verses.literalPt: Não negues o bem a quem de direito, tendo na tua mão o poder de o fazer.

verses.original: אַל־ תֹּ֘אמַ֤ר לְרֵעֶיךָ לֵ֣ךְ וָ֭שׁוּב וּמָחָ֥ר אֶתֵּ֗ן וְיֵ֣שׁ אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·mar lə·rē·ʿɛ·ḵå̄ lêḵ wā·šūḇ ū·mā·ḥār ’et·tên wə·yêš ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: Do not tell your neighbor Come back tomorrow and I will provide when you already have the means . . .
verses.literalPt: Não digas ao teu próximo: Vai e volta, que amanhã o darei, tendo-o tu contigo.

verses.original: אַל־ תַּחֲרֹ֣שׁ עַל־ רֵעֲךָ֣ רָעָ֑ה וְהֽוּא־ יוֹשֵׁ֖ב לָבֶ֣טַח אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- ta·ḥă·rōš ‘al- rê·‘ă·ḵā rā·‘āh wə·hū- yō·wō·šêḇ lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: Do not devise evil against your neighbor for he trustfully dwells beside you
verses.literalPt: Não maquines o mal contra o teu próximo, visto que junto a ti habita em confiança.

verses.original: אַל־ תָּרוֹב עִם־ אָדָ֣ם חִנָּ֑ם אִם־ לֹ֖א גְמָלְךָ֣ רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tå̄·rōḇ ‘im- ’ā·ḏām ḥin·nām ’im- lō ḡə·mā·lə·ḵā rā·‘āh
verses.literal: Do not accuse . . . a man without cause when he has done you no harm
verses.literalPt: Não contendas contra homem algum sem motivo, se ele não te houver feito o mal.

verses.original: אַל־ תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאִ֣ישׁ חָמָ֑ס וְאַל־ תִּ֝בְחַ֗ר בְּכָל־ דְּרָכָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·qan·nê bə·’îš ḥā·mās wə·’al- tiḇ·ḥar bə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵāw
verses.literal: Do not envy a violent . . . man or choose any of his ways
verses.literalPt: Não tenhas inveja do homem violento, nem escolhas nenhum dos seus caminhos.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה נָל֑וֹז וְֽאֶת־ יְשָׁרִ֥ים סוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh nā·lō·wz wə·’eṯ- yə·šā·rîm sō·w·ḏōw
verses.literal: for the LORD detests the perverse . . . but He is a friend to the upright
verses.literalPt: Pois o perverso é abominação a Jeová, mas com os retos está o seu segredo.

verses.original: מְאֵרַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה בְּבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע וּנְוֵ֖ה צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְבָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·’ê·raṯ Yah·weh bə·ḇêṯ rā·šā‘ ū·nə·wêh ṣad·dî·qîm yə·ḇā·rêḵ
verses.literal: The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked but He blesses the home of the righteous
verses.literalPt: A maldição de Jeová está na casa do iníquo, mas ele abençoa a habitação dos justos.

verses.original: אִם־ לַלֵּצִ֥ים הֽוּא־ יָלִ֑יץ וְלַעֲנִיִּים יִתֶּן־ חֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lal·lê·ṣîm hū- yā·lîṣ wə·la·ʿă·nī·yīm yit·ten- ḥên
verses.literal: He mocks the mockers but gives grace to the humble
verses.literalPt: Certamente, escarnece dos escarnecedores, mas dá graça aos humildes.

verses.original: כָּ֭בוֹד חֲכָמִ֣ים יִנְחָ֑לוּ וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מֵרִ֥ים קָלֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: kā·ḇō·wḏ ḥă·ḵā·mîm yin·ḥā·lū ū·ḵə·sî·lîm mê·rîm qā·lō·wn
verses.literal: The wise will inherit honor but fools are held up to shame
verses.literalPt: Os sábios herdarão a glória, mas a porção dos loucos é a ignomínia.
